name: schedule_job
label: Scheduled Job Information Table
description: The periodic job information table is used for filtering the enablement status related to the framework and for statistical queries based on time dimensions.

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: Global unique identifier, cross-environment import use, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
